Bash(node -e "try{const d=require\('./wc.json'\);console.log\('count =', d.count\);console.log\('competition =', d.competition && d.competition.name\);if\(d.matches&&d.matches[0]\){const m=d.matches[0];console.log\('1er match:', m.utcDate, '|', m.stage, '|', \(m.homeTeam&&m.homeTeam.name\), 'vs', \(m.awayTeam&&m.awayTeam.name\), '| tla:', \(m.homeTeam&&m.homeTeam.tla\)\);console.log\('seasons start:', d.competition&&d.filters\);console.log\('resultSet:', JSON.stringify\(d.resultSet\)\);}else{console.log\('message:', d.message||JSON.stringify\(d\).slice\(0,300\)\);}}catch\(e\){console.log\('parse err', e.message\)}")

Bash(node -e "const d=require\('./wc.json'\); const ms=d.matches||[]; console.log\('array length =', ms.length, '| resultSet.count =', d.resultSet&&d.resultSet.count\); const byStage={}; const groups=new Set\(\); ms.forEach\(m=>{byStage[m.stage]=\(byStage[m.stage]||0\)+1; if\(m.group\)groups.add\(m.group\)}\); console.log\('par stage:', JSON.stringify\(byStage\)\); console.log\('exemples de group:', [...groups].slice\(0,3\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const s=require\('./public/maps/states-10m.json'\); const c=require\('./public/maps/countries-110m.json'\); console.log\('states objects:', Object.keys\(s.objects\)\); console.log\('countries objects:', Object.keys\(c.objects\)\); const geoms=c.objects.countries.geometries; const names=geoms.filter\(g=>['Canada','Mexico','United States of America'].includes\(g.properties&&g.properties.name\)\).map\(g=>g.properties.name+':'+g.id\); console.log\('found:', names.join\(', '\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const d=require\('./wc.json'\); const m=d.matches[0]; console.log\('Champs dispo:', Object.keys\(m\)\); console.log\('venue:', JSON.stringify\(m.venue\)\); console.log\('area:', JSON.stringify\(m.area\)\); const withVenue=d.matches.filter\(x=>x.venue\).length; console.log\('matchs avec venue:', withVenue, '/', d.matches.length\); const venues=[...new Set\(d.matches.map\(x=>x.venue\).filter\(Boolean\)\)]; console.log\('venues distincts \('+venues.length+'\):'\); console.log\(venues.join\('\\n'\)\);")
